edits.old: | BR5 | An engine that finds no version in force for a table it needs does not run on stale or missing values: the client throws and the caller stops | RWB-E1-043 section 8 BR9; Principle 5; NFR-033 |
edits.new: | BR5 | An engine that finds no version in force for a table it needs does not run on stale or missing values: the client throws and the caller stops; a dated read with no version in force answers 404 with MSG-P3-027 naming the table code and the business date, and never an older version, a default row or an empty list | RWB-E1-043 section 8 BR9; Principle 5; NFR-033; GAP-0698 |

edits.old: Then the cache holds no entry for a version that is not APPROVED
edits.new:
Then the cache holds no entry for a version that is not APPROVED

  Scenario: AC11 The client serves only the eleven table codes and adds no code, status or message of its own (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the reference table codes held in LOV-REF-TABLE
    When the client is asked for the table codes it serves
    Then the eleven codes PRODUCT, REGION, EXPOSURE_BAND, ROLE, TEAM, QUEUE, SERVICE_LEVEL, DOCUMENT_TYPE, TEMPLATE, LEGAL_PERIOD and PRODUCT_PARAMETER are returned and no other code is
    Then the status vocabulary and the messages are those of RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, and the client holds no table, writes no row and reads no other service's schema

  Scenario: AC12 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stops the caller and serves no default (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case call for "QUEUE" fails or does not answer
    When the client reads "QUEUE" for 2026-11-30
    Then it throws naming table "QUEUE" and business date 2026-11-30
    Then the calling engine does not run and no default row, older version or empty list is served
